assign.card: core/Page: binding.md — the binding system, measured

assign.now: reading the slice; plan: 1 measure script (node, Property vs Item change vs re-render, 1,000 rows), 2 probe slice bugs (grandclone refresh, clone disposal) with failing checks then fix, 3 write core/Page/doc/binding.md, 4 link from readme + templates.md, 5 check_page, 6 report

log.msg: measured: 1,000 rows x 10 cells, 3 bound; results in binding/results.txt (node + headless chromium, median of 3)

decision.what: slice bug: a middle clone's set/unset never redrew its own clones (grandclone stale); fixed with Template.redraw(name) + inheritors(name)
decision.alternative: Property.Map tracks its child maps; rejected, a second record beside Template.clones

decision.what: clone death = Template.dispose(): its clones first, then views, then out of source.clones
decision.alternative: WeakRef clones list; rejected, the record vanishes silently while views may still need a refresh

decision.what: linked vs hard copy: clone() stays linked, copy() flattens every value onto one unlinked layer; overrides(prefix) lists overridden names per section
decision.alternative: a linked flag per clone; rejected, per-property override + unset already gives granular linking

log.msg: check_page: binding.md 0 page errors (1 404 = the loader's old/page.jsonl probe, also on main). Template demo 0 page errors; 540 404s on the worktree only (directory.json, weight.jsonl, settings.jsonl, page.jsonl probes for generated files main has and the worktree lacks; main shows 0).
